content:
Why I Started This Blog # Welcome to JO3INGR Security Notes.
I created this blog to document my development as a cybersecurity student, aspiring in penetration tester and Vulnerability research.
I am interested in web security, penetration testing, vulnerability research, and digital forensics.
What You Will Find Here # I plan to document my practical labs, technical experiments, cybersecurity tools, challenges, and lessons learned and writeups.
My goal is to improve my understanding by practising, documenting my findings, and sharing useful knowledge with other learners.
The Journey Ahead # I am still learning, and this blog will grow alongside my skills.
One lab, one vulnerability, and one lesson at a time.
consistency is the Key!
title: My Cybersecurity Journey
